cases.candidate_script:
set -u
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-wildcard-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> "$HOME/anchor-peer.err" & peer=$!
trap 'kill "$peer" 2>/dev/null; wait "$peer" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 wildcard) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340 BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_0X20=0
if dns query valid.wildcard.test A -s 127.0.0.2 -t 3000 --validate > valid.out 2> valid.err && [[ $(<valid.out) == 192.0.2.76 ]]; then echo wildcard=accepted; else echo wildcard=unexpected; exit 1; fi
if dns query noproof.wildcard.test A -s 127.0.0.2 -t 3000 --validate > invalid.out 2> invalid.err; then echo no-proof=wrongly-accepted; exit 1; else echo no-proof=rejected; fi
cases.purpose: Select the actually verified RRSIG when checking wildcard expansion and require a next-closer denial proof.
cases.oracle: Independent signed wildcard answer includes a forged non-wildcard first signature and correct wildcard second signature; BIND delv validates the proof-bearing case and rejects the proof-free case.
cases.comparison: Require reference controls, exact wildcard A answer, and rejection of an otherwise valid wildcard answer without authenticated denial.
